=== help
argv: --help
exit: 0
out:
  Usage: WhiteoutFlakes [--backend d3d11, d3d12, vulkan] [--wgpu-backend d3d11|d3d12|vulkan|gl] [<model-path>]
         --export-wem <out.wem>   write the model as WEM and exit
         --export-mdx <out.mdx>   write it as Warcraft III and exit
         --export-mdx-profile <n> wc3_reforged (default) | wc3_classic
         --export-mdx-no-textures do not write the textures beside it
         --export-m3 <out.m3>     write it as StarCraft II and exit
         --export-m3-profile <n>  sc2 (default) | heroes
         --export-m3-no-textures  do not write the textures beside it
         --export-m3-exact-passes Warcraft III: a draw per pass the fold
                                  would otherwise approximate
         --export-m3-sharpen-key  Warcraft III: bake keyed alpha binary
         --export-m3-war3-mod-textures
                                  Warcraft III: name War3 (Mod)'s copy of a
                                  texture where it ships the same picture
         --export-m3-no-effects   Warcraft III: write no PAR_ / RIB_
         --export-m3-no-standard-refs  Warcraft III: add no Ref_Origin /
                                  Ref_Overhead / Ref_Center / Ref_Target /
                                  Vol_Target
         --export-gltf <out.glb>  write it as glTF 2.0 and exit
                                  (.gltf writes JSON + .bin + images)
         --export-gltf-no-textures leave the texture URIs unresolved
         --save-m3 <out.m3>       re-save an open .m3 and exit
         --save-m3-merge-anims    fold the attached .m3a files in
         --save-m3-sc2            retarget a Heroes model for SC2
         --save-m3-textures       copy the referenced textures beside it
         --wem-profile <name>     open a .wem as that profile
